articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Ripped by Former Manchester United Manager Erik ten Hag, Star 'Let the Team Down'
articles.summary: Former Manchester United manager Erik ten Hag had choice words about Red Devils legend Cristiano Ronaldo when reflecting on his spell at Old Trafford.
articles.body:
Former Manchester United manager Erik ten Hag had choice words about Red Devils legend Cristiano Ronaldo when reflecting on his spell at Old Trafford.

Ten Hag asserted to The Athletic's Laurie Whitwell that Ronaldo "let the team down" during his return to the club.

"And he let me down, because we planned with him," the Dutchman said. "I flew out to Portugal to speak with him about what I was aiming for before I came to United. Obviously, he's one of the best in football history. I respected him a lot. But at that time, as a manager, I had to make a rational decision and keep the players I admire in."

Ten Hag also claimed Ronaldo "pulled out of training sessions" and didn't put forth the necessary effort when he did work out.

"I confronted him with this," the manager said. "Many times I say, 'Ronnie, everyone wants to work for you to bring you in the right position, but if you can't bring yourself in the box, you can't score'. He was not capable to do this. It's the wrong idea to put this to me that I expected him to do the pressing, that he's exhausted. But he couldn't. He ran neither in possession nor out of possession. The reason was because he didn't prepare himself."

Beyond that, Ronaldo allegedly told some of his teammates to "save your legs at the training."

Ronaldo reunited with Manchester United during the 2021 transfer window. While his 18 Premier League goals led the club in 2021-22, that obscured his overall contributions.

Even by that point, the five-time Ballon d'Or winner was beginning to decline. He compensated by becoming even more of a goal poacher, which had a domino effect on the rest of the tactical plan.

Ten Hag and his predecessor, Ole Gunnar Solskjær, both struggled to strike the right balance between using Ronaldo in his preferred role and putting the best lineup out on the pitch.

Things came to a head early into the 2022-23 season.

Ten Hag left Ronaldo out of the squad altogether for a match against Chelsea after he refused to come on as a substitute in United's previous fixture. Weeks later, the Portuguese attacker offered his side in an interview with Piers Morgan.

"I don't have respect for [Ten Hag] because he doesn't show respect for me," Ronaldo said (via ESPN's Rob Dawson ). "If you don't have respect for me, I'm never gonna have respect for you."

He went on to say he "felt betrayed" by some senior executives at Old Trafford.

United announced days later Ronaldo was leaving by mutual consent with immediate effect.

This saga is merely one facet of the extended dysfunction that has plagued the club ever since Alex Ferguson retired in 2013.

Ronaldo was more of a vanity signing for Manchester United and one that was likely driven by keeping him away from rival Manchester City. There was no real plan for how he fit tactically, leaving Solskjær and ten Hag to sort out the mess. Everyone witnessed the result.

Ten Hag wasn't a popular figure when he got the boot in October 2024, but supporters are probably looking back a little more positively on his tenure when he delivered FA Cup and EFL Cup triumphs.

In a lot of cases, a former coach calling out a star on the level of Ronaldo years after the fact can backfire. Some may instead see Ten Hag's interview with Whitwell as reflecting the kind of direct management sorely lacking at United for more than a decade.

articles.title: HSFB HC Miles Smith Reportedly Resigns After Dismissing QB for Changing Play, Suspending 12 Players
articles.summary: The high school football coach who dismissed his starting quarterback for calling an audible and suspended 12 other players for supporting him is now out of a job himself.
articles.body:
The high school football coach who dismissed his starting quarterback for calling an audible and suspended 12 other players for supporting him is now out of a job himself.

Per Kolby Marting of 12News in Arizona, Desert Ridge head football coach Miles Smith has announced his resignation. Smith's dad, Lovie Smith, a former NFL head coach who was volunteering on his son's staff, also won't return to the team.

Senior quarterback Gunner Brewer told Griffin S. DeMarrais of KTVK 3TV in Arizona that Smith kicked him off the team following the Oct. 2 game against Vail Cienega High School after he changed a play that was originally called for him and instead handed the ball off to his running back.

"I basically got the play, but in the huddle, I was thinking to myself like... I have a running back who can run the ball better than me, so I'm gonna trust in my guy," Brewer said. "So, I changed the formation to put him in the backfield with me, and for him to run the ball."

Brewer added that his offensive coordinator had previously given him permission to change plays, but Smith still made the decision to remove him from the roster. Following Brewer's dismissal, 12 other players who spoke up in his defense during a team meeting were also suspended for the remainder of the season.

According to Marting, a source said that "the administration wants to allow some of those kids who were dismissed to be able to return this season and play again."

articles.title: Champions League: What are the yellow card suspension rules?
articles.summary: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains what the rules are regarding yellow card suspensions in this season's Champions League
articles.body:
In the Champions League, players will receive a one-match ban should they receive four yellow cards.

This rule runs from the start of the league phase until the end of the quarter-finals. After then, all yellow cards are wiped out and players cannot be suspended for multiple yellow cards.

The same rules apply for both the Europa League and the Conference League.

During the opening two rounds of Champions League, five players received two yellow cards, meaning they are entering this week's third round of matches two cautions away from a one-match ban.

Players can also be suspended if they pick up six, eight or 10 yellow cards. This would also result in a one-match suspension every time a player hits an even number of yellow cards above four.

articles.title: Lionel Messi breaks own Guinness World Record with six species named in his honour: All the insects, animals, fossils, fungi, and plants
articles.summary: Lionel Messi has broken his own Guinness World Record with the naming of a sixth species, the Salvia messii, a sage plant discovered in the Peruvian Andes. This article explores the significance of the plant, its characteristics, and Messi's enduring legacy in football and science.
articles.body: A sage plant discovered in the Peruvian Andes has become the sixth species named after Lionel Messi, extending a record already shared by a lizard, spider, fossil brachiopod, condor and fungus. The newly described Salvia messii carries Argentina’s familiar blue and white colours in its flowers, but the tribute comes with a troubling detail: researchers have classified the plant as endangered.A new plant carries Messi’s name into the AndesSalvia messii is a sage species endemic to the Andes of central and southern Peru, where it grows on rocky, arid slopes between 2,000 and 2,400 metres above sea level. It belongs to the mint family, Lamiaceae, which includes plants associated with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties.The plant can grow to approximately 1.5 metres tall, with pale blue and white flowers that resemble Argentina’s national colours. Those colours make the choice of namesake especially fitting for a footballer who represented his country across a career spanning more than two decades.The name follows botanical naming conventions, which often adapt a person’s surname into Latin. The ending “i” indicates possession, so Salvia messii can be understood as “Messi’s sage”.The species was described by researchers led by Paul Gonzales of the Natural History Museum at the National University of San Marcos, alongside Argentine researcher Rolando Uria and biologist Jean Capcha-Ramos of Huarango Nature. Their study appeared in the October edition of the botanical journal Phytotaxa.The plant’s restricted range and endangered classification give the discovery significance beyond its unusual celebrity namesake. Its name may draw attention to the species, but its survival depends on protecting the mountain habitat where it grows.The sixth species added to Messi’s recordIn May 2024, Guinness World Records recognised Messi as the footballer with the most species named after him, recording five at the time. Salvia messii now brings that total to six.Scientific nameSpeciesLocation or originYearLiolaemus messiiIguanian lizardRosario de Lerma, Argentina2021Acanthogonatus messiiBurrowing spiderArgentine Patagonia2023Discinisca messiFossil brachiopodMiocene-era Argentina2023Vultur messiiFossil condorPliocene-era Argentina2023Cercopemyces messiiFungusAndean cloud forest, Salta Province, Argentina2024Salvia messiiSage plantPeruvian Andes2026The names span living animals, prehistoric fossils, fungi and now a flowering plant. The fossil condor and brachiopod also show that the honour is not limited to species alive today.Messi’s record is unusual, although he is not the only footballer whose name has entered scientific classification. Diego Maradona has been associated with four named organisms, but one, the fairy wasp Anaphes maradonae, was later found to be the same species as an earlier-named wasp and is therefore no longer considered valid.What the names say about Messi’s legacyMessi’s name has reached science through a series of researchers choosing to recognise his influence, rather than through any single award or official campaign. The latest example connects his sporting identity directly with Argentina’s colours, even though the plant itself grows across the border in Peru.The tribute also arrives after a remarkable international career. Messi made his senior Argentina debut against Hungary on 17 August 2005, briefly retired from international football in 2016, then returned to lead the team through its major successes.He captained Argentina to Copa América titles in 2021 and 2024 and the 2022 World Cup triumph in Qatar. Messi has made 208 appearances and scored 126 goals for Argentina, winning the Ballon d’Or eight times. He scored in Argentina’s 3-0 victory over Benin in his final international match earlier this month. Now 39, he continues his club career with Inter Miami and has also been nominated among the 30 contenders for the 2026 Ballon d’Or.Messi is not the first footballer honoured by scienceThe practice of naming newly described organisms after footballers goes back further than Messi’s record. In December 2009, researchers named 12 newly described microcaddisfly species after members of Brazil’s 1958 World Cup-winning team, including Pelé, whose name was given to Neotrichia pelei.Maradona’s scientific namesakes include a fossil damselfly, a parasitic fluke and a sea snail, alongside the wasp later found not to be a distinct species.For Messi, the new sage adds another entry to a record already recognised by Guinness, while also drawing attention to a plant whose future is less secure than the footballer’s place in the sport’s history. articles.standfirst: 'El Corrillo' es el tiempo de Opinión de Directo MARCA
articles.summary: 'El Corrillo' es el tiempo de Opinión de Directo MARCA
articles.body: Alberto Pérez, Nacho Labarga, Santi Siguero y José Miguel Muñoz debaten sobre la actualidad deportiva en 'El Corrillo' de Directo MARCA junto a Rafa Sahuquillo con la jornada Champions y la polémica arbitral en el foco del debate. La polémica arbitral vuelve a situarse en el centro del debate futbolístico a las puertas del Clásico entre Real Madrid y Barcelona. En la tertulia de Radio MARCA, los colaboradores analizaron las últimas jugadas controvertidas y las declaraciones de Fran Soto, presidente del Comité Técnico de Árbitros (CTA), quien defendió el nivel del arbitraje español: "Estoy convencido de que el nivel medio es el mejor del mundo". Soto también pidió aislarse de la presión mediática y de las críticas de clubes y entrenadores: "Nosotros tenemos que trabajar, trabajar en lo nuestro, trabajar, trabajar y trabajar". Sin embargo, las palabras del presidente del CTA contrastaron con las críticas escuchadas durante el programa. Uno de los comentarios más contundentes llegó al abordar las imágenes de la conversación entre Ricardo de Burgos y Pedri durante el Betis-Barcelona: "Eso es tremendo, es tremendo", se escuchó en la tertulia, antes de cuestionar el tono de algunas conversaciones arbitrales: "El compadreo a veces de los árbitros para con según qué equipos y jugadores". La intervención puso el foco en la transparencia de las comunicaciones arbitrales y en la confianza que generan determinadas decisiones, en una semana marcada por la tensión competitiva y mediática. La acción entre Arda Güler y Peque también alimentó el debate. Mientras algunos aficionados reclamaron una posible expulsión del madridista, las opiniones reflejaron la división existente en torno al criterio arbitral. Incluso Joan Laporta dejó abierta la puerta a comentar la jugada más adelante: "Del Madrid ya habrá tiempo para hablarlo a partir de mañana". Con el Clásico en el horizonte, el arbitraje vuelve a ocupar los titulares antes de un partido de máxima rivalidad, mientras el CTA insiste en defender a sus colegiados y reclama trabajar al margen del ruido mediático.

articles.title: Teemu Pukki: Former Norwich City and Finland striker to retire
articles.summary: Former Norwich City and Finland striker Teemu Pukki announces his retirement from football at the age of 36.
articles.body:
Former Norwich City and Finland striker Teemu Pukki has announced his retirement from football at the age of 36.

Pukki, who quit international duty last year, is Finland's men's all-time top scorer with 43 goals in 133 matches, while his number of caps is the country's second highest.

He scored 88 goals in 210 appearances for Norwich between 2018 and 2023, helping the Canaries twice win promotion to the Premier League.

"I've gained a lot more from football than I ever dreamed of when I was a little boy," Pukki wrote on Instagram. , external

"I've seen the world and gained experience because of football and I don't think I could have gotten anything like football anywhere else.

"It hasn't always been fun or I haven't been able to enjoy it, but the love for football has remained - always. Big thanks to the great clubs and their fans."

He has played for HJK Helsinki in his homeland since 2025 and will retire following the conclusion of the Veikkausliiga season on 8 November.

Pukki also counts Schalke, Brondby and Minnesota United among his former clubs, while he scored nine goals in 38 appearances for Celtic between 2013 and 2015.

Pukki party memories will live on - analysis

There was a time when if you told a stranger you were a Norwich fan they would reply with "Jeremy Goss!"

In the last few years that has been replaced with "Teemu Pukki!"

The unassuming Finn arrived on a free transfer in the summer of 2018 to very little fanfare. Pukki's previous foray into British football had been with Celtic and their supporters were quick to tell Norwich fans that their new acquisition wasn't up to much.

With the help of one Emi Buendia teeing him up, Pukki cemented himself as an all-time Norwich great, winning two Championship titles, two player of the season awards and reaching fourth place among the club's all-time leading scorers.

That partnership with Buendia was the stuff of dreams for Norwich supporters and was described as "magical" by head coach Daniel Farke.

Thank you, Teemu. You will always be welcome to throw a 'Pukki Party' in Norfolk.

articles.title: El Madrid reclama a seis clubes ingleses que paguen su parte de la fallida Superliga
articles.standfirst: Según The Athletic, el club blanco considera que los seis equipos de la Premier que se sumaron al proyecto en 2021 siguen obligados a asumir una porción de los costes iniciales, pese a haberse retirado
articles.summary: Según The Athletic, el club blanco considera que los seis equipos de la Premier que se sumaron al proyecto en 2021 siguen obligados a asumir una porción de los costes iniciales, pese a haberse retirado
articles.body: El Real Madrid reclama a los seis clubes ingleses que firmaron el proyecto de la Superliga europea que abonen la parte proporcional de los costes iniciales de la competición, finalmente abandonada. Así lo informa el diario británico The Athletic, que cita a varias fuentes conocedoras de la situación. Según esa información, el club blanco sostiene que Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United y Tottenham siguen siendo responsables de los gastos de puesta en marcha del plan, a pesar de que se descolgaron de él poco después de su anuncio, en abril de 2021. Una de las fuentes consultadas por el medio cifra el montante total de esos costes en hasta 80 millones de euros. Hasta ahora, el Real Madrid ha compartido los gastos promocionales de la Superliga junto al Barcelona y la Juventus. El resto de los doce clubes fundadores —los seis ingleses, el Atlético de Madrid y los dos equipos de Milán, Inter y Milan— se retiraron en los días posteriores al lanzamiento. La Juventus anunció su salida en 2023 y el Barcelona formalizó la suya en febrero de este año. La clave del litigio reside en la interpretación del acuerdo de accionistas que los clubes firmaron con la sociedad que gestionaba el proyecto, con sede en España. The Athletic apunta que la disputa girará en torno a si la cláusula que comprometía a los clubes a “poseer y gestionar conjuntamente” la competición incluye también obligaciones económicas. En su día, el presidente Florentino Pérez defendió que los contratos eran vinculantes y que los clubes “no podían marcharse”. La reclamación coincide con la inminente incorporación al Real Madrid de Bernd Reichart, ex consejero delegado de A22 —la empresa que ha gestionado el proyecto de la Superliga—, como nuevo responsable de operaciones de negocio del club, una vez resuelta su salida de dicha compañía. Según fuentes del club citadas por el medio, cualquier cantidad adeudada correspondería a la sociedad de la Superliga, no directamente al Real Madrid. Tanto A22 como los seis clubes ingleses declinaron hacer comentarios. El propio análisis subraya que la resolución no se prevé rápida: los documentos filtrados del proyecto no mencionan de forma expresa el reparto de costes, por lo que, de no haber acuerdo, el Real Madrid tendría previsiblemente que acudir a los tribunales para reclamar esas aportaciones.

articles.title: Camavinga pierde el 'efecto Zidane'
articles.standfirst: Ninguna titularidad tras regresar de la selección y apenas 25 minutos en el campo
articles.summary: Ninguna titularidad tras regresar de la selección y apenas 25 minutos en el campo
articles.body: Dos semanas han pasado desde que Camavinga regresó de 'subidón' de la selección. El centrocampista fue una de las novedades en la primera convocatoria de Zidane, participó en los cuatro partidos (jugó 204 minutos) y fue titular en los dos triunfos ante Bélgica. Tras su dolorosa ausencia del Mundial, la nueva llamada en el comienzo de la 'era ZZ' suponía un impulso para el jugador, en su intento de remontar la delicada situación deportiva que atraviesa en el Real Madrid. Pero el 'efecto Zidane' se ha ido diluyendo si que haya supuesto un cambio en la situación que tiene en el Real Madrid. Camavinga se fue a la selección siendo un suplente habitual (dos titularidades en siete partidos) y a su regreso lo sigue siendo (tres suplencias, una de ellas sin minutos, en tres partidos). El '6' jugó 13 minutos ante el Villarreal, ninguno frente a la Roma y 12' frente al Sevilla, para un total de 25 minutos en los tres últimos compromisos. Desde que el Madrid volvió a la competición tras el parón, Camavinga es el centrocampista con menos minutos de la plantilla, por detrás de Valverde, Bellingham, Güler, Tchouaméni y Bernardo Silva. Sólo ha jugado más que Thiago Pitarch, con ficha de Castilla, y que sigue inédito a estas alturas de temporada. Camavinga no sale del túnel deportivo en el que anda metido desde hace mucho tiempo, primero por culpa de las lesiones y después por su cuestionado rendimiento. En los tres últimos meses de la pasada temporada sólo fue titular en cinco partidos de los 17 que disputó el Madrid entre Liga y Champions. Thiago Pitarch lo adelantó por la derecha y se convirtió en actor secundario. Una situación que lo dejó sin Mundial. En el comienzo de la presente campaña nada ha cambiado. Mou le ha hecho algún guiño que otro ("hoy un chico que no es muy amado ha hecho un partidazo", dijo el técnico tras el triunfo ante el Málaga el pasado 30 de agosto), pero el campo dice otra cosa. El caso es que Camavinga lleva meses alejado de los focos y perdiendo cada vez más protagonismo. Una situación que lo llevó a que el pasado verano su continuidad en el Real Madrid no estuviese asegurada. "Perderme el Mundial me afectó. Este tipo de decepción fue algo nuevo para mí, pero lo más importante es levantarse", reconoció Camavinga durante una comparecencia en la última concentración con Francia. "Desde que empezó mi carrera todo ha ido muy rápido, pero Roma no se construyó en un día y todavía tengo mucho tiempo delante", apuntaba. También hizo autocrítica: "Tengo que estar más concentrado en el terreno de juego y cometer menos fallos". El tiempo pasa y nada cambia para Camavinga, que ve en el Leipzig una nueva oportunidad para recuperar parte del protagonismo perdido.

articles.title: New Arch Manning Rumors Reveal What It Would Take for Texas to Bench QB amid Struggles
articles.summary: Despite his recent struggles, University of Texas quarterback Arch Manning is reportedly not considered to be in imminent danger of getting benched.
articles.body:
Despite his recent struggles, University of Texas quarterback Arch Manning is reportedly not considered to be in imminent danger of getting benched.

Anwar Richardson of Orangebloods.com reported what sources told him about the situation, writing, "I was told that it would take a 's---ty performance' against Ole Miss for Texas football coach Steve Sarkisian to bench Manning. Sarkisian and his staff are trying to get everything they can out of Manning, and I do not sense that he is on a short leash heading into this weekend. However, my only disclaimer is that you never know what decision a coach might make in the heat of the moment, especially if frustration starts to set in."

Arch Manning's tenure with Texas may be nearing end

For his part, Manning spoke to reporters on Monday, making it clear he's determined to turn things around:

Since a 4-0 start that included wins over then-No. 1 Ohio State and then-No. 14 Tennessee, the Longhorns have dropped back-to-back games, falling 27-24 to both Oklahoma and Florida.

Manning was nowhere near his best in either of those losses, going 19-of-31 for 260 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions against Oklahoma, and 14-of-20 for 173 yards with one touchdown and no picks against Florida.

The nephew of legendary NFL quarterbacks Peyton and Eli Manning, Arch was expected to do big things during the 2026 campaign.

Last season marked his first as the starter at Texas, and although he had his ups and downs, he finished the year with 3,163 yards, 26 touchdowns and seven interceptions through the air, plus an additional 10 rushing touchdowns.

The 2026 season represented an opportunity for Manning to cement himself as the best quarterback in the 2027 NFL draft class and the potential No. 1 overall pick.

He hasn't done that thus far, though, as his numbers are somewhat pedestrian to the tune of 1,295 passing yards, 11 touchdowns and five interceptions to go along with no rushing touchdowns.

The Longhorns have a highly touted quarterback behind Manning on the depth chart in sophomore Karle Lacey Jr., who was a 4-star recruit in the class of 2025, per 247Sports .

Lacey has played sparingly, attempting just one pass last season, and going 7-of-8 for 63 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions this season.

Per Richardson, Sarkisian would prefer for an inexperienced quarterback like Lacey to not have to play against No. 7 Ole Miss on Saturday night, writing, "From what I gathered, throwing Lacey into the fire this weekend is not Sarkisian's ideal scenario."

While Texas has the benefit of playing at home on Saturday, Ole Miss presents a massive challenge, as the Rebels are 5-1 and battle tested, as they reached the College Football Playoff semifinals last season.

Texas is still ranked No. 19 in the nation, but at 4-2, it may not be able to afford another loss as it relates to contending for a CFP berth.

While Ole Miss is seemingly the toughest team left on Texas' schedule, games against ranked opponents in Missouri and LSU are still to come as well.

Manning may still give the Longhorns the best chance to win, and while Richardson's report suggests Sarkisian does not want to make a change, that ultimately lies in the hands of Manning and depends on his performance.

articles.standfirst: Los de Ipurua son el único equipo de segunda que han marcado en las 10 jornadas.
articles.summary: Los de Ipurua son el único equipo de segunda que han marcado en las 10 jornadas.
articles.body: La exigencia se ha multiplicado para el Eibar en las últimas semanas. Los pupilos de Jokin Aranbarri se han enfrentado en apenas seis días a dos huesos como Real Oviedo y Mallorca, recién descendidos de Primera y candidatos al ascenso con todas las letras. El balance es de un punto de seis posibles después de encadenar siete triunfos para firmar la mejor racha de su historia. Algo que era esperado y que no cambia para nada el semblante de la plantilla. El conjunto armero se ha subido a dos escenarios de máxima complejidad, sobre todo el pasado sábado durante casi una hora de juego ante el Mallorca, pero en ambos ha tenido capacidad para salir adelante y disponer de momentos para generar situaciones claras de gol. De hecho, frente a Oviedo y Mallorca, dispuso de numerosas ocasiones. Tantas como en otros muchos partidos que acabó venciendo gracias a su eficacia. El Eibar aún no sabe lo que es quedarse sin marcar en este inicio de temporada. En todos sus compromisos ligueros ha visto puerta en una muestra clara de su capacidad goleadora. De hecho, los de Aranbarri son el único equipo de todo Segunda que han sido capaces de hacer gol en estas 10 jornadas. Ni Almería y Castellón, los dos primeros clasificados y que mantienen el pulso goleador con el Eibar, cuentan todos sus partidos con tantos a favor. Hasta diez jugadores han contribuido a que el Eibar sea el equipo más realizador del campeonato. De entre todos sobresale Iván Gil, con 4 dianas en 9 partidos. Guzuzeta (3) sigue la pista del catalán, mientras que Adu Ares, Magunazelaia, Mada y Álvaro Rodríguez suman dos tantos. Martón, Bautista, Aleix Garrido y Pejiño también han contribuido con un gol. articles.summary: Sufre una rotura en el bíceps femoral de la pierna izquierda y aún no hay fecha de regreso
articles.body: David González sufre una rotura en el bíceps femoral de la pierna izquierda que le mantendrá alejado de los terrenos de juego durante un periodo todavía por determinar. El futbolista se lesionó el pasado domingo frente al Sabadell y las pruebas médicas han confirmado el alcance de la dolencia. La lesión se produjo apenas un día antes de que el conjunto blanquinegro anunciara la renovación del centrocampista burgalés hasta junio de 2031, asegurándose la continuidad de uno de los jugadores más importantes de su proyecto deportivo. De esta manera, la alegría por su ampliación de contrato ha quedado acompañada por la preocupación sobre su estado físico, aunque desde la entidad no se ha establecido un plazo de recuperación. David González, de 24 años, regresó al Burgos en 2024 después de su paso por la cantera del Real Madrid y ha conseguido hacerse un hueco importante en el equipo gracias a su calidad y capacidad para generar juego ofensivo. Ahora, Sergio Francisco tendrá que reorganizar sus opciones en el centro del campo para afrontar los próximos encuentros sin uno de sus efectivos habituales. El futbolista ya ha comenzado el tratamiento correspondiente y su vuelta dependerá de la evolución de la lesión. El objetivo será completar la recuperación sin asumir riesgos que puedan comprometer su regreso a la competición

articles.title: Burnley: What is the longest a team has gone without winning at home?
articles.summary: Burnley are on the brink of unwanted football history, should they fail to beat Portsmouth later this month.
articles.body:
Burnley will set an unwanted English football record if they fail to beat Portsmouth in their next home match on Saturday, 31 October.

The Clarets have not won a home league match since beating Leeds United 2-0 in the Premier League on 18 October, 2025.

Sheffield Wednesday currently hold the record for the longest time a team in England's top four divisions have gone without winning a home league match.

The Owls failed to win a league game at home for 376 days between April 2025 and May 2026.

Burnley's match against Pompey in the Championship later this month comes 377 days after that win over Leeds. Should the Clarets fail to beat John Mousinho's side, they will hold the outright record.

The record does not include teams that have dropped out of the English Football League and returned to the EFL since.

Only teams to have been on a winless run while in one of England's top four leagues are considered.

Following that win over Leeds 12 months ago, Burnley have played 21 home league matches. The last six of those were in this season's Championship, with the previous 15 coming in last season's Premier League.

Of those 21, Burnley have been held to 10 draws and lost the other 11 fixtures.

Burnley did win in the FA Cup at Turf Moor in January 2026, beating Championship side Millwall in the third round. They were then knocked out in the fourth round by Mansfield Town, again at Turf Moor, meaning another home defeat for the Clarets.

In this season's Carabao Cup first round, Burnley beat Notts County but required a penalty shootout to do so.

articles.summary: El delantero ha 'mojado' en 11 temporadas consecutivas en Italia
articles.body: Gio Simeone empezó bien la semana. El delantero del Torino marcó un doblete el lunes ante el Parma (0-3) y conquistó este récord: sólo tres jugadores han anotado en cada una de sus primeras 11 temporadas en la Serie A. Giovanni ha 'mojado' en las 11 temporadas de la Serie A que disputó desde su arribo a Italia en la 16/17, cosa que sólo han hecho Piotr Zielinski y Matteo Politano. Simeone, sumando las cifras de las 11 campañas, tiene 86 goles en 337 partidos de Serie A. Su recorrido en Italia atravesó seis equipos desde la 2016-2017 hasta la 2026-2027. Su recorrido italiano comenzó en el Genoa (35 partidos y 12 goles). Después pasó a la Fiorentina: en 2017/2018, con 38 encuentros y 14 dianas. En la temporada siguiente sumó 36 partidos y seis goles con ese club. En la 2019/2020, Gio pasó al Cagliari, con 12 goles en 37 partidos. En la temporada siguiente, seis dianas en 33 encuentros. Luego jugó en el Hellas Verona, donde brilló con 17 goles en 36 partidos durante la 2021/2022. Más tarde, en el Napoli, con tres temporadas consecutivas, antes de este Torino, donde, en su primer año, disputó 32 partidos y marcó 11 goles la pasada campaña. Y es que Gio ya es un clásico en Italia.

articles.body: A pesar del empate en Eibar, el Mallorca va poco a poco pareciéndose a lo que quiere Luis García. Mereció más en Ipurua en un partido que se saldó con empate gracias a un penalti (el segundo) señalado a favor del Eibar en el tiempo añadido. El equipo continúo con la buena línea de la victoria ante la UD Las Palmas el pasado 11 de octubre. Sin embargo, el ruido en cuanto al juego en la isla hasta estos dos últimos partidos cada vez se hacía más grande. Por eso, el Mallorca se ha beneficiado de su dominio de las áreas para cosechar los 18 puntos que lleva en el casillero. Portero y delantero están siendo dos de las figuras más importantes del equipo en lo que llevamos de temporada. Arnau Tenas es el portero con más porterías a 0 de la categoría junto a Matthys, con un total de 6, además de ser el segundo portero menos goleado con 5 tantos encajados, uno más que el meta del Castellón. El portero catalán está recuperando su mejor nivel con la elástica bermellona con paradas salvadoras en varios encuentros, incluso parando un penalti en Eibar, y se está erigiendo como uno de los hombres más importantes del plantel del técnico asturiano. En área contraria, Adrián 'Estampida' Fuentes es un auténtico depredador del gol. El madrileño suma 6 dianas y una asistencia y es el máximo realizador de la categoría junto a Miguel de la Fuente, Enric Gallego y Álvaro Marín. Apenas es su segunda campaña en el fútbol profesional, a pesar de sus 30 años, y la está aprovechando al máximo. Gol, trabajo y efectividad al servicio del equipo. Fuentes es el delantero que más despejes hace de toda la Liga Hypermotion (9) y es el que más goles esperados tiene (5,5 xG). Además, ha necesitado 11 disparos a puerta para hacer 6 goles, prácticamente 1 de cada 2 acaba en el fondo de la portería rival. Ocho jornadas ha tardado el Mallorca en encontrar su mejor juego (veremos si dura) pero, mientras tanto, ha ido cosechando puntos gracias a dominar las áreas con Arnau Tenas y Adrián Fuentes, dos hombres que han recalado este verano en la isla y, en apenas unos meses, ya se han colocado la vitola de imprescindibles.

Los principales clubes continentales buscan sumar más puntos para tomar posiciones tempranas de cara a la clasificación final. Esta emocionante fecha inicial pondrá a prueba el nivel físico de las plantillas de élite, que buscan situarse rápidamente en la zona alta que otorga el billete directo. En este innovador sistema de competición, los ocho primeros clasificados al finalizar la liguilla obtienen el billete directo a los octavos de final. articles.title: Arsenal coach Arteta always a leader, says former teammate Gnabry
articles.summary: Bayern winger Serge Gnabry is not surprised former teammate Mikel Arteta became a successful coach, saying the Arsenal boss was always a leader in the dressi...
articles.body:
Bayern winger Serge Gnabry is not surprised former teammate Mikel Arteta became a successful coach, saying the Arsenal boss was always a leader in the dressing room.

Gnabry, who started his club career at Arsenal, will go up against Arteta's Gunners at the Allianz Arena on Wednesday in the Champions League.

"He was certainly a leader within our team back then. He was the captain during the season we played together," Gnabry told reporters on Tuesday.

"I remember him helping us out. He shared a lot of advice with us. He was always very approachable and open.

"That just goes to show what a kind person he is. He led the team to great success. It's not that we saw it coming, but he's clearly developed further and has done a fantastic job."

The 31-year-old Germany international admitted it was "strange" to face a team coached by a former teammate, but added: "It's a special match for me -- playing against my former club.

"The club where I spent many years, I grew up there from the age of 16."

Already without the suspended Michael Olise and the injured Jamal Musiala, Bayern come into the match with doubts around coach Vincent Kompany, captain Manuel Neuer and midfielder Joshua Kimmich.

Kompany is suffering from a virus and may not be in the dugout, while Neuer is fighting to return from injury and Kimmich, who would captain the side in Neuer's absence, missed Tuesday's training due to personal reasons.

English assistant coach Aaron Danks took Tuesday's press conference and could step in for Kompany on Wednesday, but said there would be no extra personal motivation for the match.

"I think it's always Bayern Munich's victory. I know Vince would be really strong on this, it's never about anybody's individual achievements, it's always about the collective, about the group," he said.

"When you come to work with a club like Bayern Munich, you know it's much bigger than all of us."

Kompany was on the sidelines for Saturday's 6-1 win over RB Leipzig in the Bundesliga but had difficulty walking and did not take the post-match press conference.

"For me, not too much changes," Danks said.

"I plan the training sessions every day, and I take quite a lead on the grass. Obviously, when Vincent's not with us, we miss him, we miss having him around...

"You have to really get him to rest, but it's a challenge. You know him as a person, he's a real leader, he works hard, so it's important that he rests."

articles.title: “Dives all over the place” Graeme Souness attacks another Arsenal player
articles.summary: Graeme Souness has shifted his attention away from Declan Rice, at least for now, and has instead criticised another Arsenal player after making fresh commen...
articles.body:
Graeme Souness has shifted his attention away from Declan Rice , at least for now, and has instead criticised another Arsenal player after making fresh comments about Bukayo Saka.

Saka has established himself as one of the Premier League's leading right wingers in recent seasons. Arsenal value his contribution across competitions, and he remains important for both club and country.

Despite Saka's consistent performances, he remains a target for criticism. Souness has questioned the winger's conduct during matches, accusing him of going to ground too easily when challenged by defenders.

Saka often faces physical treatment from opponents and sometimes attempts to stay on his feet under pressure. However, Souness believes the Arsenal forward dives too frequently, particularly when he risks losing possession.

The criticism is notable given Saka's importance to Arsenal, where his attacking output makes him a key figure. Nevertheless, Souness has made clear that his concerns are about what he sees as simulation rather than the winger's ability.

(Photo by Richard Heathcote/Getty Images)

Souness accuses Arsenal winger of diving

During a conversation with Piers Morgan, Souness delivered a blunt assessment of Saka's behaviour. As quoted by the Daily Mail , he said:

'Your man Saka dives all over the place. I don't want to hear about him. The minute he looks like losing possession, he's down. 'He simulates a foul. Anyone who simulates a foul in my book would be a cheat. 'He dives when he should be staying on his feet. He's not alone. So Saka gets tackled, he screams as he's going down.'

Souness's comments reflect his disapproval of players he believes exaggerate contact or attempt to win free kicks unfairly. His criticism adds to the scrutiny Saka faces whenever his reactions to challenges become a talking point.

For Arsenal, Saka remains a central part of their plans, while Souness has made his position on the player's conduct clear.

articles.title: Sven Botman tackle: Howard Webb says nothing 'clearly wrong' with VAR decision to not send Newcastle defender off
articles.summary: Pro Ref chief refereeing officer Howard Webb analyses Sven Botman's tackle on Nicolas Jackson after pundits' call for red card; Webb also backed the decision to send off Rodrigo Bentancur vs Man Utd; Watch Match Officials Mic'd Up at 6pm on Sky Sports News
articles.body:
Sky Sports pundits widely criticised referee Jarred Gillett for showing only a yellow card and the VAR Stuart Attwell for backing the on-field call in Newcastle's 1-0 defeat to Villa on Saturday.

"If VAR can't see that's a red, we're in trouble," said Sky Sports ' Jamie Redknapp. "It is so dangerous. How he's not broken his leg there... I like to see aggression. I want to see 50/50 tackles, but you can't do that anymore."

After the game, Jackson told Sky Sports: "The referee said it was a yellow card but it was so high. Hopefully next time it is a red card. I nearly broke my leg, but it's fine. It's part of football."

Former Premier League referee Dermot Gallagher said on Ref Watch : "I think it's a red card. It's got everything for a red card tackle - it's got speed, intensity, he scissors him."

Sky Sports' Jay Bothroyd added: "Botman is more violent conduct than the headbutt [from Yehor Yarmoliuk at Brentford ]. He could have broken his leg."

However, Webb believes the incident reflects this season's approach of VAR not re-refereeing on-field decisions.

On Match Officials Mic'd Up , he said: "We've seen quite a lot of robust tackling in the Premier League. This weekend we saw quite a few examples of strong tackles going in; it's part of the English game, the Premier League and what people like. We want to embrace that but we also have a responsibility to ensure players' safety.

"Many of those situations that we've seen with those types of tackles are subjective - the referee's having to make a determination in the moment on how much force is used and the nature of the tackle.

"We've really tried to encourage referees this season to make decisive on-field decisions, and in this situation we see the referee make a judgement on Joelinton's tackle by playing advantage and then Botman comes in.

"The referee in the moment, on the ground, sees it as a reckless challenge - no doubt a high-end reckless challenge - as Botman comes in and gets a touch on the ball.

Webb: It's a good example really of how the referee's call is working

"There's obviously some speed he comes in with. The VAR looks at that decision and tries to identify whether that was clearly wrong.

"We don't want the referee's decision to be re-refereed by the VAR; we want the referee to have ownership of the decision and the VAR to only step in when there's an element that's clearly wrong.

"So if the VAR had seen strong stud contact from Botman's extended leg into the ankle or shin of Jackson, or there had been a closing of the scissor, I think we'd have probably come out with a different outcome after the VAR had looked at it.

"But he doesn't see that. He realises it's subjective, and he allows it to stay on the field with the referee's call standing.

"Equally, if that had been a red card, for sure it would've been check complete by the VAR as well.

"So, it's a good example really of how the referee's call is working in the Premier League this season. A lighter-touch approach: let the referees referee the decision and the VAR step in when there's something clearly really wrong."

VAR - Stuart Attwell: "I don't like that. Right, so he hits the ball; he goes over the top of the ball. He doesn't go studs into the leg, but he goes round it with a scissor challenge."

Attwell watches multiple replays and asks the AVAR: "What are you thinking?"

Assistant VAR - Craig Taylor: " I think he plays the ball and there's limited contact with the player's leg."

VAR: "It's not with the studs, is it? It goes round him."

AVAR: "It's not with the studs. It's not a clear point of contact."

VAR: "There's no secondary scissor action."

VAR: "Jarred, confirming yellow card for Sven Botman and confirming yellow card for Joelinton. Two reckless tackles."

Rogers and Palmer tackles not analysed by Webb

Morgan Rogers escaped a red card in a similar incident during Chelsea's 2-0 win at Everton on Saturday before his team-mate Cole Palmer avoided a second yellow card for a late challenge.

Webb did not address the tackles in Tuesday's edition of Match Officials Mic'd Up.

Former Premier League referee Mike Dean said on Soccer Saturday that Rogers deserved at least a yellow card, which would have sent him off after he was booked earlier. On Ref Watch , Bothroyd and Tim Sherwood both agreed it should have been a straight red card.

Bentancur red and Shaw yellow were 'right outcome'

Webb said Rodrigo Bentancur's red card and Luke Shaw's yellow card after the pair clashed in Tottenham's 1-1 draw at Manchester United were "absolutely the right outcome".

Bentancur was sent off for headbutting Shaw after retaliating for being pushed over by the United left-back at Old Trafford in October.

"When players make contact with their head, they're running a really high risk. It's seen as a violent act," said Webb.

"When we apply the laws of the game, we differentiate between the neck, face and head compared to contacts into the chest. For us not to send off for contact into the face or head, it has to be deemed negligible and in this case it's not.

"It's a fairly forceful act by Bentancur. You could argue the push by Shaw is also forceful but it's in the chest. You don't often see players sent off for pushes to the chest.

"A yellow card for Luke Shaw, but it has to be a red card for Bentancur reacting in the way he does with his head."

articles.body:
Muy buenas tardes y bienvenidos al directo de este partido. El Liverpool y el Villarreal se enfrentan en un partido correspondiente a la jornada 3 de la Champions League . El encuentro se disputa este martes 20 de octubre a las 21.00 horas en Anfield . Los ingleses suman seis puntos y quieren seguir mirando hacia arriba en Europa, mientras que los españoles tratarán de lograr su segunda victoria para escalar posiciones.

El Villarreal afronta una de las salidas más exigentes en la Liga de Campeones con el objetivo de dar un golpe sobre la mesa en Anfield frente a un Liverpool que, arropado por su afición y por la historia de su estadio, exigirá el máximo al conjunto castellonense en un encuentro que pondrá a prueba su capacidad para competir lejos de casa.

Enfrente, el Liverpool buscará aprovechar el factor Anfield para imponer su ritmo, presionar al Villarreal y llevar el peso del encuentro. La intensidad de los ingleses y su capacidad para convertir las pérdidas del rival en ocasiones de peligro obligarán al conjunto amarillo a mantener la concentración durante los noventa minutos.
